scope: Tiny paired local contracts;root-owned runtime qualification is separate.

cases.title: Validate the generated skewed fixture
cases.input_contract: Require 20000 rows, IDs 0..19999,100 keys and total ID sum 199990000. Explain key 0 occurs 16040 times.
cases.expected: Exact population tuple 20000,20000,100,199990000;key 0 count 16040, other keys 40.
cases.verification: Compare aggregate counts and the independent formula 16000+4000/100.

cases.title: Measure the two-partition configuration
cases.input_contract: Execute the bounded grouped query under a unique job group, read actual executed metrics, measure partition row counts and persist/read back the product.
cases.expected: 100 exact key/count pairs, total 20000;nonempty retained stage evidence;one or two data files.
cases.verification: Compare all rows with the literal formula before accepting any work/time report.

cases.title: Compare four partitions without assuming a speedup
cases.input_contract: Repeat with 4 partitions and a separate output directory.
cases.expected: All 100 result tuples match the same oracle;four buckets sum 20000 and one to four files are observed.
cases.verification: Assert parity and print actual elapsed time/file/metric values without an ordering claim.

cases.title: Interpret work imbalance and spill honestly
cases.input_contract: Compute maximum bucket rows divided by mean bucket rows;report available dataSize, shuffleBytesWritten and spillSize metrics without inventing missing values.
cases.expected: Both observed work ratios exceed 1;unavailable metrics remain None/None-equivalent.
cases.verification: Assert row conservation and positive ratio, then print exact available metric maps and stage receipts.

cases.title: Compute a separate hypothetical cost model
cases.input_contract: Use a hypothetical rate 0.05 currency units per vCPU-hour and 0.02 per GiB-month. Evaluate 2 vCPUs for 1 hour plus 2 GiB retained for 30 days under a30-day month.
cases.expected: Estimated 0.14 currency units, not an actual cloud bill or a price recommendation.
cases.verification: Check each unit conversion and reject negative durations/resources.

cases.title: Enforce the stop budget before scaling data
cases.input_contract: Accept only row counts 1..20000 and partition counts 1..8 for this local exercise. Reject an attempted larger fixture before constructing it.
cases.verification: Assert both refusals and confirm the session shuffle setting restored to 2.

golden.metrics_scope: actual classic SQL operator metrics;partition row imbalance is a proxy,not task duration
